name: Soukou Musume Senki
description:
Plansız bir saha gezisinde Riko, Mimesis olarak bilinen metal tabanlı yaşam formlarının dünyayı kasıp kavurduğu alternatif bir Japonya'ya götürülür. Sadece LBX zırhlı silahlarla donatılmış kızlar bu belaya dayanabilir. Yerinden edilmiş diğer dört genç kadına katılan Riko, insanlığı kurtarmak için uyum sağlamak zorunda kalacak. Artık bir gezegenin umudu, bir dilek arzulayan bu ağır metal askerlere bağlı.

(Kaynak: Funimation)

episodes.name: The Day I Fell Into a Battlefield
episodes.description: Ordinary girl Riko finds herself transported to the middle of a war, and she doesn't have the slightest idea how to fight!

episodes.name: Chosen Girls
episodes.description: Trapped in her new world, Riko will be forced to fight to survive. But first, the team makes a stop at a local base, where the locals have a request.

episodes.name: The Battle of Gotenba
episodes.description: It's time for Riko's first mission as an Assassin. But nobody knows how to be an Assassin, so nobody can teach her…

episodes.name: The Legendary Super-Builder Otacross
episodes.description: An unexpected detour takes the girls to a hot springs inn, filled with yummy food and a chance to relax!

episodes.name: The Old Capital, Conquered
episodes.description: The gang arrives in Kyoto, and Riko is looking forward to her first time in the ancient city. There's sightseeing and fun, and a clue to something that may save mankind…

episodes.name: Special Move: Attack Function
episodes.description: The girls have found a potential way to end the war against the Mimesis, but first they have to get it out of an enemy-infested city.

episodes.name: Suzuno's Secret
episodes.description: With the SWITCH safely stowed onboard, the team stops in Shikoku for a break. But Suzuno has a secret, and is in no mood to have fun…

episodes.name: The Terrifying Ammonite
episodes.description: An encounter with a powerful Memisis blocking the path to Fukuoka brings back terrible memories from Kyoka's past.
